name: Sonora Steak Asadero El Prieto #13
notes: Taco truck with 5 photos: 2 illustrated picture-menu boards (item names/descriptions), and 2 separate handwritten price boards with meaningfully different prices for the same items (e.g. Taco Normal $3.70 vs $2.55, Burritos $13.90 vs $7.88) — used the higher/first price board (1.jpg) as current and only pulled unique items (Papa Light, Combo 1, Combo 2) from the second (5.jpg), which is why confidence is medium rather than high. Base protein is a choice of carne asada, chicken breast, al pastor, or veggie unless a variant already names its meat (e.g. Lamb Taco, Campechano).
